proposal.reason: Main substantive change is CI/test-execution infrastructure: the daily workflow now supports generated datasets, builds temporary case inputs from JSON families during prepare, and produces/upload a full performance Excel report from retained run artifacts. New xtest generator/report scripts, test-list definitions, and validation tests all support CI dataset selection, grouping, reconciliation, and reporting behavior; retention-day edits are incidental workflow housekeeping within the same CI scope.
